correctness.rationale: The fort predicate tests nonempty white sets with no outside vertex having exactly one neighbor inside. The terminal white set of a failed process is a fort, and a disjoint fort cannot receive its first force; every fort contains a minimal one by finiteness. Independent enumeration in cardinality order tested all 16384 subsets, kept a fort only if it contained none of the already found smaller minimal forts, and evaluated synchronous closure against hitting on every seed. The polynomial coefficients at degrees 6–14 were 700,1904,2401,1862,987,364,91,14,1 (sum 8324); every inclusion-minimal forcing set had size six. Single deletion detects forcing minimality because forcing is monotone, and was not used for fort minimality. Generic adjacency-preserving bijection enumeration, not an assumed polarity, found 336 automorphisms; the two fort orbits matched the representative masks 30 and 1524 and sizes 14 and 56. All size-four forts are the specified one-sided quadrangles; every mixed fort has induced degrees 0,1,1,1,1,1,1, hence three disjoint edges and an isolate. Five forcing orbits have sizes 28,168,168,168,168 and times 2,2,3,3,3, giving totals 196 and 504. Replay: python3 /workspace/branches/independent_heawood.py, output independent_heawood.out alongside. No skew or positive-semidefinite forcing, alternative time convention, or larger incidence structure is verified.

The 14 quadrangles are literally the Type A minimum decycling sets of 83a003d33b54. A mixed fort maps to a Type B minimum decycling set by retaining its isolate and its three vertices on the opposite side. The inverse adds the unique private neighbor on each of these three opposite-side lines (or dually points); three lines avoiding a fixed point cannot be concurrent, since through any other point one of the three lines passes through the fixed point.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The Type B indexing explains the shared count 56 by an equivariant correspondence: the isolate and three opposite-side vertices determine the matched endpoints because each endpoint lies on only its own of the three lines. But the decycling theorem does not assert that this reconstructed seven-set is a minimal fort, nor that all minimal forts arise that way. Hitting equivalence is prior method, not an evaluated Heawood fort classification.

value.rationale: The remaining obstruction census and well-forcedness are useful beyond counting minimum seeds: the fort clutter decides every initial configuration by transversality, and well-forcedness rules out locally irreducible larger seeds and makes the optimum family generate the entire forcing family. The full polynomial quantifies that family for a canonical Fano incidence graph. Value does not rest on having rediscovered the known minimum or the covered optimum orbit and timing data.
